releases.notes:
## Chunk Randomizer 2.3.0 — Sulfur Update

Chunk Randomizer has been fully migrated to **Minecraft Java Edition 26.2**.

### Highlights

- Updated to Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3, and Fabric API 0.155.2+26.2.
- Built for Java 25.
- Preserves the established gameplay-focused blacklist instead of broadly excluding interesting blocks.
- Adds the new Sulfur and Cinnabar stairs, slabs, and walls to the blacklist.
- Excludes Potent Sulfur, Sulfur Spike, and Golden Dandelion because mass placement causes problematic behavior or severe lag.
- Keeps the existing `/rc` commands, Chunk Walker Boots, optional chunk effects, fluid setting, and custom session exclusions.
- Includes regression tests for the migrated block candidate pool.

### Installation

Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API for Minecraft 26.2, then place `ChunkRandomizer-2.3.0.jar` in your Minecraft `mods` folder.

`ChunkRandomizer-2.3.0-sources.jar` is provided for developers and source inspection; it is not required for normal gameplay.

The migration and final gameplay changes were successfully built and playtested.

[VERSION] Modrinth VERSION 2.1.0

- added all _wall/_brick_wall and _staris blocks zu blacklist
- added commands for custom blacklist blocks and clearing
- reduced effects durations from 30s to 8-16s

🧪 Chaos Mechanics (New Updates)
🌪 Dynamic Chunk Effects
Every time you cross a chunk border, you might get hit with a random status effect.

Duration Update: Effects are no longer a flat 30 seconds. They now last randomly for either 8 seconds or 16 seconds.

Stability: Effects are seeded to the chunk. The same chunk will always give the same effect.

🚫 Performance & Exclude System
If you encounter blocks that cause lag (like certain modded blocks or complex entities), you can now exclude them in real-time.

Use /rc exclude add minecraft:... to prevent a chunk from turning into a lag-fest.
